mutants.description: Start-up from S_OFF checks only the host enable over SPI and forgets the physical switch en_SW
mutants.reason: With spi_enable high, en_SW low and no fault, the FSM leaves S_OFF for S_SS. The next clock S_SS sees ~g_en and goes back to S_OFF, so ss_active and state_out toggle every clock while the switch is off, but en stays low.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
after: if (~spi_enable | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
mutants.description: In S_RUN only a host disable over SPI is checked: turning off the physical switch gates en but does not send the FSM to S_OFF
mutants.reason: Turning en_SW off in S_RUN pulls en low but leaves state_out at S_RUN with run_active high. When the switch comes back on, en goes high again straight into S_RUN with no soft-start ramp.

mutants.description: The combinational en gating applies only the host enable, so turning off the physical switch waits for the FSM to register S_OFF
mutants.reason: When en_SW falls in S_SS or S_RUN, en stays high for one more clock until state becomes S_OFF, instead of dropping on the same clock.

mutants.description: run_active drops on the clock window_trip fires, a clock before the FSM leaves S_RUN for S_HICCUP
mutants.reason: When an overcurrent window trip happens in S_RUN, run_active falls one clock early while state_out still reads S_RUN, so the port no longer means 'high only in S_RUN'.

after: state_out     = (OTP | UVLO | latch_state | latch_assert) ? S_OFF : state;
mutants.description: Telemetry state_out reports S_OFF as soon as a hard fault gates en, instead of the registered present state
mutants.reason: When OTP, UVLO, latch_state or latch_assert rises in S_SS, S_RUN or S_HICCUP, state_out reads S_OFF one clock before the state register does, while ss_active, run_active or hiccup_active still show the old state.

mutants.description: A start request blocked in S_OFF by OTP or UVLO is treated as a recoverable fault and sent into the S_HICCUP cool-down instead of holding S_OFF
mutants.reason: If the converter is enabled while OTP or UVLO is high, the FSM switches between S_OFF and S_HICCUP: hiccup_active and state_out pulse every other clock, and each entry counts as a strike, instead of the FSM staying in S_OFF.
